_comment: Foundation registry — the deliberate allowlist for dataset eve_core (the set chat recall prefers). Policy: docs/MEMORY_GOVERNANCE.md sections 1-3; legacy wiring note in section 7 step 5. eve_core may contain ONLY entries named here or generated from them. Reasons matter more than the list: an entry without a category/reason is not registered. Evidence for why this file exists: scripts/optimize_eve_memory.py scores candidates by keyword regex, and that heuristic put NotebookLM exports (name bonus '+55' for 'nlm') at the TOP of Foundation and left 'unmatched-*.txt' harvest residue and '_1.md' duplicates inside. Scoring ranks; the registry decides.

replaces_scoring_rule.observed_defect: name.casefold().startswith('nlm') grants +55, so NotebookLM reference exports outrank project knowledge; unguarded duplicates (_1.md, X.md.md) and 'unmatched-*' residue pass the >=8 threshold
replaces_scoring_rule.status: recorded 2026-09-26; scorer left unchanged pending the curated rebuild (needs re-embed, Architect sign-off)
replaces_scoring_rule.note: This registry does not change what is embedded. It records what is ALLOWED to be, so the rebuild has a target and the drift is measurable.

categories.standing: standing preferences, house rules, the Architect's profile (MEMORY_GOVERNANCE section 2)
categories.decision: decisions with their rationale, to be referenced later
categories.definition: definitions and vocabulary she is expected to use consistently
categories.method: methods and workflows the Architect is actively working on
categories.derived: generated FROM registered sources (provenance is the generator, not a human)

registered.reason: the Architect's standing profile: how he works, what he expects

reference_only._comment: MEMORY_GOVERNANCE section 3: reference material is reached BY NAME (config/library.json), never embedded. These patterns are known to be inside eve_core today - that is the drift this file measures.

forbidden._comment: Structurally defective or never-embed. Presence in eve_core is a defect regardless of score.

wiring.gate: advisory in scripts/mechanic-green.ps1 until the curated rebuild lands (MEMORY_GOVERNANCE section 7 step 5); becomes fatal after it
